dict.string: Aroh uses the microphone so you can log food, water and workouts by voice.
Aroh turns your voice into text on this iPhone to log food, water and workouts. Audio never leaves the device.
Aroh reads your weight, workouts, steps and dietary energy from Apple Health to fill the trackers of your goals.
Aroh writes test samples to Apple Health only in developer builds.
Aroh reads your calendars so plans avoid the time you are busy. Nothing is written back.

Aroh uses the camera so you can take a photo and attach it to a goal for its agents.
Aroh opens your photos so you can attach one to a goal. It syncs only to your account, for that goal's agents.
Aroh notices the places you visit often and asks you to name them. Visits stay on this iPhone.
Aroh nudges you when you reach a place linked to a goal, even while it is closed. Visits stay on this iPhone; only the places you name and the routines you approve sync.
